name: t109_guard_p1c
headline: Human Written
windows: Whichever protective part showed up, try talking to it in the same Nurturer voice you meant for your little one. At some point you can ask that part, “What are you afraid would happen if you stepped back?” It puts you into the role of the Nurturer, which alleviates the instinct to argue back. Usually your little one only comes forward after that part feels heard.

name: t109_guard_p3c
headline: AI Detected
windows: That part might say this will just be one more performance, and you’ll fool yourself again. That one can sting, because there could be something to it. Maybe you’ve fooled yourself before, and that part remembers.
“Tell me what you remember, I’m listening.” works well here.

If you push past it, you might get exactly the performance it was afraid of. Even if you didn’t win an Emmy last year, that can look convincing, with the right words and maybe even tears, while nothing underneath feels any safer.
